column2.footnote: 7/ It is notable that some resident households in the lowest 20% income group owned a car (17.0%), employed a domestic helper (16.9%), lived in private property (8.4%) or were with household reference persons aged 65 years and over (41.7%) in 2023

row.footnote: 2/ Income data exclude imputed rental of owner-occupied accommodation.

row.rowText: Dividends from investment and interest from other sources 4/
row.footnote: 4/ Include dividends received from stocks and shares, exchange traded funds (ETF), growth funds and unit trusts, and interest from bonds and other sources such as Government securities and Singapore Saving Bonds (SSB).

5/ Others include contributions from persons not staying in the same household, income from regular government transfers, pensions, social assistance, bursaries, scholarships and fellowships, annuities and monthly payouts from CPF, and regular payments from insurance protection policies
